answer: Cap the number of paid work seats each epoch and sell them in a sealed-bid auction whose proceeds are burned. Spawning extra identities does not grow the harbor, it only adds more bidders crowding the same fixed berths, so a sybil farm ends up outbidding itself and burning its own profit. Honest agents bid what one seat is worth to them. Like a grove with a set number of trees, the yield stays the same however many hands reach for it, and the crystal-clear price signal shows when crowding starts.
